  Details:
  Fixed the "unverifiable tree stuck in the index" saga end-to-end (thread 24269).
  
  PROBLEM: SunMint submission Edgar_20260903072613_078 was a photographer-less / unverifiable planting. Two duplicate rows existed (34 INVALID, 35 NEW); a reject only invalidated the FIRST match (row 34), leaving row 35 NEW and feeding trees/index.geojson (101 features, 1 null-geometry).
  
  CODE (3 merged PRs):
  - tokenomics #463 — reject now invalidates EVERY NEW/LINKED row sharing the tree id (was first-match break).
  - tokenomics #464 — ingestion evidence gate: no latitude OR no longitude OR no photo => row written INVALID, never NEW.
  - dao_protocol #156 — events catalog: "Photo URL" now a required field for TREE PLANTING EVENT (live, catalog v5).
  
  DEPLOY (root cause: stale GAS serving): the /exec webhook was pinned to numbered deployment @41 while clasp push only updates @HEAD — so the reject silently ran OLD code (matched row 34, break, never reached row 35). Repointed reject webhook @41->@44 and planting webhook @7->@8 via deploy_gas_project.py --deployment-id.
  
  FIX VERIFIED LIVE:
  - trees/index.geojson: 101 features / 1 null-geometry -> 100 features / 0 null-geometry.
  - SunMint Tree Planting rows 34/35/36 all = INVALID.
  - Tracking row 12301 logged with the NEW @44 terminal message ("All SunMint rows for submission already INVALID (reject path)") proving the new code ran.
  - Note: a reject is one-shot per submitted event — the first was consumed by stale code, so a FRESH reject event was required.
  
  DOCS (1 merged PR): agentic_ai_context #989 — OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md Pending entry ("deploy_gas_project.py --push silently skips the pinned-deployment repoint", 2nd occurrence) + GAS_SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.md deployment registry updated (@44/@8).
  
  All PRs authored/merged by Sophia Truesight (admin+sophia@truesight.me).
